## Checklist

- [ ] Tests use a temporary folder, never real user data
- [ ] A change to what `move` writes is undone by `undo`, and a test compares the tree before the move with the tree after the undo
- [ ] Token cost: unchanged, or stated here and in the README's "What it costs in tokens"
